SELECT SUM(s.Enrollment (K-12)) AS TotalSATTestTakers
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.School Code = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.FRPM Count (K-12) = (SELECT MAX(FRPM Count (K-12)) FROM frpm);

SELECT SUM(s.Enrollment (K-12)) 
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.FRPM Count (K-12) = (SELECT MAX(FRPM Count (K-12)) FROM frpm);

SELECT SUM(T1.SATtestTakers)
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(NumTstTakr) AS SATtestTakers
    FROM satscores
    JOIN frpm ON satscores.cds = frpm.CDSCode
    GROUP BY frpm.NCESSchool
    ORDER BY COUNT(frpm.NCESSchool) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) T1;

SELECT SUM(s.NumTstTakr)
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f.FRPM_Count_K_12 = (SELECT MAX(FRPM_Count_K_12) FROM frpm);

SELECT SUM(s.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.FRPM_Count_K_12 DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode

FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` = (SELECT MAX(`FRPM Count (K-12)`) FROM frpm WHERE `School Type` = 'K-12 Schools (Public)');
